notes.title: The V9.99 version update game will switch to free mode in one week
notes.notes:
Although I have put a lot of effort into this game, as my first independent game, I am proud because it is an excellent open world RPG. However, due to art and some gameplay design reasons, this game does not have commercial value. I hope to switch to a free mode for interested players to try, which can also be considered as an explanation to myself. At the same time, I have also prepared English localization for this, let this game be a commemoration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42960567/ab92fa5d1d8e8b559ad69c42ae5e3e255a79f0df.png[/img]

notes.title: V1.0.3补丁更新说明
notes.notes:
桑尼镇酒吧老板，老米先生近期不知从何处搞来了两台娱乐机器：
一台叫沙雕跳舞机，一台叫爆负老虎机。

小镇居民其乐融融，又多了不少消遣（钱），致富的娱乐手段！！！ 
快来体验吧，牛仔!!!! 

对了，这些设备没有接入西部银行系统哟，老米已经改装过了，大家可以直接使用身上的牛币投币哦，特别方便，祝您玩的愉快！

notes.title: V1.0.2 版本更新
notes.notes: 很抱歉由于新增了部分多语言设置相关内容，导致游戏的部分对话系统可能会出现bug,作者已经快马加辫修复了，大家更新下steam版本到最新版就能解决了！！

notes.title: V1.0.1版本更新公告！！！！ 久违了牛仔们！
notes.notes:
1 靴马的CD判定修改，现在仅当玩家受伤时会进入冷却状态，纯粹切换武器或者攻击未受到伤害不会进入冷却。
2 武器【星之神臂】的大师技【爆能战车】机制优化，现在只有在战车护甲归零时才会进入冷却，并且新增机制： 在战车状态下点击【Q】键可以开启/关闭 后座力模式
也就是说，各位牛仔们可以更快乐的骑马和开坦克了，去探索这个世界吧！

notes.title: V2.1.7重大版本更新说明 - 武器平衡性调整，玩法加强
notes.notes:
1 ColtSAA左轮手枪新增大师技调整：
【决斗心流】单击鼠标右键,短时间内减缓时间流逝的速度,期间伤害翻倍，冷却15S。非简单模式下，此技能无法在决斗姿态下使用！
 【死神之眼】非决斗状态下10%概率造成5倍伤害。
2 神奇飞刀 -  修正伤害类型为穿透。可穿透敌人，不可穿透建筑。
3 M1891莫辛甘娜狙击枪 - 修正子弹类型为穿透。
大师技调整：
【宁静】（被动技能）架枪时缓慢回复血量，每秒恢复最大生命值百分之2。
【绝情】(被动技能)子弹将加快飞行速度，盲狙状态下，50%概率伤害翻倍，开镜状态下，伤害100%翻倍。
4 仙蛛手 基础伤害调整
  25~50   -> 50 ～ 80
5 星之神臂 普通状态基础伤害调整
50~69   -〉 80~109
6 orb264手雷被子弹引爆时，将造成三倍伤害。【非大师技】
7 当ColtSAA或M1891产生暴时，子弹尾流将变成红黑色！

notes.title: 西部幻想正式版【远星歌姬】更新公告
notes.notes:
挤了半年的业余时间爆肝，西部幻想正式版本终于和他家见面了~~~
以下是版本更新内容：
1 全新大地图，木薯群岛。这是一座不被西部大陆地图所记载的神秘岛屿群， 拥有独特的生态，长年被精明的木薯精所盘踞，因此得名。然而，更可怕的是岛上云集的传说强者....
2 天气系统，越接近沿海的地区越容易下雨和打雷。天气状况将和怪物、生态、玩家武器之间产生联动。
部分敌人在雨天时将会更加强大,技能效果也会产生变化，使用金属类武器在打雷时将更加危险。
3 新的武器
【走狗】此武器击败大部分人形生物时，可将其转化为玩家的走狗，为玩家而战。基于游戏庞大的NPC群体，你将通过和不同的走狗配合，产生无穷的乐趣。
【仙蛛手】你将像蜘蛛侠一样，通过蛛丝快速在地图间穿梭，自由探索，抵达神秘角落，也可以在战斗中犀利的调整走位，就像兵长砍巨人那么帅气。
【羽械派*无颜一刀】灵感来源星海镖师，攻守一体的近战武器，一刀两断爆发高，一木成林格挡神技！
【星之神臂】化身机甲战士，操纵爆能战车，击碎敌人的不败传说！
4 靴马进化！！
人气宠物靴马可以通过游戏里收集的小零件进行攻击或防御能力的强化，十步杀一人，千里不留行。
5 全新冒险剧情、超有料！！！刺激？恶搞？狗血？看似荒诞，但其实何尝不是少年的一场幻梦？
去拯救这个世界吧，纵使前方强者如云，也要击破他们不败的传说。
6 新的小怪【热爱科学的小蜘蛛】【可爱迷人的刺星海胆】【各怀绝技的木属精】等，可不要小看他们的智商，虐过的菜比你吃的饭还多。
7 最终战役【传说之塔】，献给头号玩家的巅峰战记，荷尔蒙爆棚、酣畅淋漓的战斗，打通必哭~
8 马老师、虚坤老师等世外高人强力助阵，他们虽然不是boss,但也有可能成为boss,成为你的噩梦...
9 基于新武器build设计的小游戏和解密，更多的宝箱等待你发现。
10 决斗系统焕然新生，1 v N 才是牛仔本色！！单挑什么的弱爆了。
11 加入场景小地图，妈妈再也不担心我迷路。
12 部分NPC加入配音，感谢粉丝们的倾向献音。

ps:配音工作持续进行中，感兴趣的小伙伴加QQ群：761236793。喜欢什么类型的角色随便挑，专不专业无所谓，快乐就完了。
新版本相关steam成就会慢慢补上.

notes.title: V1.0.28 UPDATE LOG
notes.notes:
The artistic expression of the following contents has been improved:

1 Hotels, bars, police stations, ranches and weapons stores in Sunny Town

2 Road signs outside Sunny Town

3 Gold coins and big money bags dropped in the game



Experience optimization of radish pulling games:

1. Fixed the bug that when checking the radish, the radish sometimes disappeared ahead of time, causing players to not see the color clearly.

2 During calibration, players will not be able to pull out the next radish in advance.



When creating a new game archive, you will be provided with difficulty options:

[Apple - Cute and Cute]

The initial capital is 500N.

Bullet time can be used in duels.

20% additional injury reduction for resident

Maximum satiety value 100

[Banana - ordinary player]

The initial capital is CNY100.

Bullet time is not allowed in duels.

Additional injury immunity without permanent residence

Maximum satiety value 100

[Watermelon - World Expert]

The initial capital is N $0.

Bullet time is not allowed in duels.

No permanent residence will cause additional damage reduction, and the damage taken will be increased by 20%.

Maximum satiety value 50



Defeat any final boss in the human expert mode to unlock the new Steam achievement [human expert].



The three pigs in the Miracle Wilderness have added a broken treasure chest with good rewards.

notes.title: v1.0.27 update log
notes.notes:
1 The boss [Qi Tian Da Sheng]'s ability to draw land as a prison has been strengthened. When players are imprisoned, they will suffer a rune damage and their movement speed will decrease in a short time, which will make them more linked with subsequent skills.

2 The damage bonus of the weapon [Aeolus Bow] from the legendary hunter buff is weakened, and players are still encouraged to cause high damage gains through high-risk face operations, but the gains decrease when shooting from a distance.

3 The harrowing pig man will now be prompted before he heavy attack. As a price, we have improved the mobility and

Ability to change behavior rhythm.

notes.title: V1.0.26 UPDATE LOG
notes.notes:
1 The upper limit and lower limit (- 30 to 30) of honor value have been increased, and more detailed information about honor value can be obtained by police officers.

2 No matter the honor value is positive or negative, you can pay money at the police station.

3 When the honor value reaches 30, you will enter the [Reputation] state and be immune to the next fatal damage.

4 In the task prop [Sanwa's Letter], the hint of the influence of honor value on the main line of the game has been added.

5 The mission of Sneaker Falling into the City, Slim, can be triggered normally.

6 A new sign has been added to Sunny Town ranch to remind cows and cows of their sacredness (of course, the current version is inviolable)!

notes.title: 2022 10/30 update log
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug that the item [Single Mushroom] restored HP that did not match the description.

2 New Moon City has added an ordinary treasure chest.

notes.title: V1.0.25 update log
notes.notes:
1、 The Bar in Sunny Town added the lovely windmill before.
2、 Boss [Wukong] optimization:
1 The speed of throwing/retrieving gold hoop rods has been increased.
2 The starting point of "Draw on the Ground" is no longer fixed. Players need to make more on-the-spot changes.
3 The avatar will be summoned. The avatar can be broken, but the blood bar is hidden.

notes.title: 2022 10/25 updatelog
notes.notes:
1 Optimize the novice tutorial, and add the keyboard key position indicator diagram.

2 Boss [Mysterious Old Man] rewards are adjusted. After the irony option is selected during the dialogue, you can obtain [essence of the Star] and related achievements only after the challenge is successful. If you challenge ordinary difficulty, you will get a magic drink [Jiannanchun] after success.

3 Fixed a bug that caused the system to crash when the fist hit the stone.

notes.title: 2022 10/24 V1.0.24 update log
notes.notes:
1 The skill mechanism of Boss [mysterious old man] is optimized, and the determination of slashing and piercing will be more accurate. And when players try to escape, they will even more arouse Boss's desire to attack. Face difficulties bravely, cowboy!!

2 NPC Pig Man [Aba Aba] is newly added near ShalowCity's Hotel. Dialogue can trigger mysterious new challenges and unlock new treasure chest!

3 Increased the draw speed of the four hidden wanted criminals, making the duel more exciting!

notes.title: 2022 10/24 V1.0.23 UPDATE LOG
notes.notes:
【1】、 The patrol route of the Wanted Miracle Wilderness criminal [Huang Ganmei] has been modified to avoid his love at the bridgehead with Little Yellow Scarf. (A pair is a pair if separated)

【2】、 The patrol route of the wanted criminals in Liberty City [Marketplace Thieves] has been modified. They sometimes feel reluctant to part with Gao Laozhuang's watermelons.

1. After the sword pillar falls, it will no longer generate crushed ice immediately. Instead, it will generate crushed ice after a short delay, allowing players enough time to adjust their positions.

notes.title: V1.0.16 Major Updates
notes.notes:
1、 The duel mechanism has been modified, becoming more exciting and interesting! Now, the conditions for triggering a kill in a duel posture are relaxed. Players can enter the duel posture when they are moving. They can fire a kill bullet as long as they do not draw the gun in advance. As a remedy, players will not be able to use the master skill [Bullet Time] in the duel!

2、 Balance adjustment:

【1】 Bony Dragon Anis's bone spur skill range has been enhanced, and his HP has been slightly increased.

【2】 The Mac has added a mechanism that will break the whirlwind chop into a short hard straight after being hit by a detonated grenade. This will make the players more proactive in the process of fighting McLaren! It is no longer the opportunity before.

【3】 The life of the puppet summoned by the boss in the second stage is slightly increased to prevent players from killing the puppet without brains.

【4】 The secret skill of # 0 machine * Shark chopping iron will add hit and blood sucking. Players need to break the barrier more actively to prevent him from returning blood.

【5】 The Great Sage of Qitian has been strengthened in all aspects. Heihei, the details are confidential.

3、 New cowboy dress [pink memory]. Players can find a new NPC [old A corn] in Sunny Town after passing a custom at will in EA version, and get this reward through dialogue! This is the exclusive reward dress for EA players!

4、 The expected fist master skill [Fight Cows Across the Mountain] has been completed. Players are requested to explore their own learning methods.

5、 The Sanyu Island [Divine Bow Burst] Challenge adds 140 and 200 bonus points, which can quickly increase the proficiency to 50 and 100, respectively, so that the veteran can pass the second pass.
